messages:
Maya Chen: heads-up — saw a regression on canary for int8 profiles after last deploy. Token latency up ~20% for long-context runs when KV cache hit rate >70%. Blocking canary rollout.

Sasha Ivanov: uh ok, which stacks/hosts? any reproducer?

Maya Chen: repro in canary eu-west-1, model rdx-3b-int8, perfbench run id: pb-20260318-11. Small script to reproduce attached:
```bash
python perf/run_gen.py --model rdx-3b-int8 --prompt samples/long_prefix.txt --tokens 512 --repeat 20
```

perf-bench: CI job pb-20260318-11 shows p50 latency 180ms -> 220ms (20% reg), p95 420ms -> 540ms. Trace indicates a dequant step spike on the kv_lookup path.

Priya Patel: can you paste the flamegraph or perf report?

perf-bench: giving snippet:
```text
# flamegraph top stacks
dequant_copy  34%
kv_cache_apply 22%
attention_kernels 15%
batching_scheduler.poll 10%
```

Sasha Ivanov: interesting — dequant_copy shouldn't be that high. Last week we changed batching scheduler to prioritize large batches which added an extra dequant -> quant roundtrip when KV cache applied (PR #4021).

Jordan Walker: git bisect result?

Maya Chen: ran quick bisect, points to commit 4f3b2a7 Merge PR #4021 "batching: prioritize size-based windowing". Quick log:
```text
commit 4f3b2a7
Author: Sasha
Date: 2026-03-16
    batching: prioritize size-based windowing
```

Sasha Ivanov: ack. That PR changed kernel selection timing and materialization of KV cache entries — we added a deferred re-quantize for mixed cache hits.

Priya Patel: is this only for INT8? any impact on FP16/FP8?

perf-bench: FP16 unaffected, FP8 small noise. INT8 shows worst due to dequant path overhead.

Maya Chen: CI perf job failed too: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/99876 — test perf/int8/throughput timed out. ci-bot pinned.

ci-bot: [automated] Job 99876 failed: perf/int8/throughput (timeout). See logs: https://ci.internal/logs/99876

Jordan Walker: can we patch the scheduler to skip the re-quantize when cache hit ratio > 50%? sounds feasible — avoids extra buffer copies.

Sasha Ivanov: quick fix: only apply re-quantize for heterogeneous micro-batches where kernels require different quant formats. I'll open a hotfix PR.

Maya Chen: timeline? canary is blocked, rolling back may be quickest.

Sasha Ivanov: I'll try hotfix; if not green in 30m revert.

Jordan Walker: I'll prepare revert PR just in case. @perf-bench please re-run perf runs once PR is up.

perf-bench: running perf now on hotfix branch, will post results.

(40m later)

perf-bench: hotfix PR #4048 pushed. perf run pb-20260318-12 results: p50 182ms, p95 430ms — much closer to baseline. diff ~2%.

Maya Chen: 
Sasha Ivanov: landing hotfix now. Canary rollout unblocked :tada:

Jordan Walker: postmortem ticket created: INF-789 — include bisect, flamegraph, root cause (re-quant overhead when KV cache present), mitigation (hotfix + tests), follow-up (add CI perf test simulating high KV hit ratios).

Priya Patel: add a targeted unit test in batching scheduler + a perf baseline job for int8 long-context.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone. keep an eye on canary for next 2 hours.

perf-bench: ack, monitoring.
